written.headline: Bipartisan congressional efforts to regulate AI face legislative obstacles
written.summary: Bipartisan efforts in Congress to regulate artificial intelligence are gaining momentum. However, these initiatives face obstacles due to the slow pace of legislative work and turf battles between members of both parties.

written.headline: Florida man sentenced to 47 months in prison for AI voice crypto scam
written.summary: A US judge sentenced David Anthony Sanchez to 47 months in prison for using artificial intelligence to impersonate Kick streamer N3on in a cryptocurrency fraud scheme. The scheme defrauded memecoin organizers of approximately $260,000 through fake accounts and AI-generated voice recordings.
